value.author: Yousef
value.title: Exceptional
value.text:
My stay at The Point Hotel Taksim as excellent, everything was of the highest standard, from the cleanliness of the rooms to the comfort of the stay, the staff were friendly and professional, and the service was exceptional I would also like to extend my sincere thanks to Ms. Ece, Ms. Sila and Ms.Eylol for their warm welcome and care throughout my stay, you made my visit a truly memorable experience.
— Nill

value.author: Mariam
value.title: Excellent
value.text:
Clean and location
— My room was very noisy because the restaurant with the floor upstairs so all the night the sound and noise was very loud 
The door opposite the room was locked and open with a very loud noise

value.author: Michael
value.title: Hotel allows smoking in their rooms
value.text: — This is a smoking hotel. Carpet in the room stinks of cigarette smoke and according to staff all rooms are the same. Spa closes on Sunday at 7pm but it's not mentioned anywhere on booking.com page. Front end associate told me that spa is open until 9pm during check in only to find out otherwise once I got to the spa 15minutes before they closed it at 7pm !

value.author: Pyotr
value.title: Exceptional
value.text:
Персонал отличный, дружелюбный. Все что мы просили всегда помогали. Расположение отеля хорошее  - до площади Таксим 5 минуть идти пешком. На площади есть метро и фуникулер на Босфор.
— В номере не работали некоторые розетки и освещение. Хотелось бы что бы в номер приносили побольше воды.
